question: At what residual depth does the `last`+period+`the` source-state bank become sufficient to causally transfer the aspectual decision?
population: The 64 valid A1/A2 discovery rows, with both transfer directions and both constructions retained.

interventions.boundary_semantics: 0 is normalized token embedding; n>0 is residual state after block n-1
interventions.operator: simultaneously replace the named positions by paired donor residual states at one boundary, retaining every other base state and the exact base suffix
interventions.final_subject_control: bound from the parent residual sweep; no boundary 0-9 passes the fixed 0.50 target recovery bar and resid:10 is the first pass

predictions.pred_a_exact_instrument: Manual native scored logits match the checkpoint backend within 1e-4, every source position is aligned, and source-bank boundary 0 is exactly inert because its three token identities are unchanged.
predictions.pred_b_source_bank_onset: At least one source-bank boundary 1-9 has A1 and A2 mean recovery at least 0.50 and direction fraction at least 0.80 in each family.
predictions.pred_c_earlier_than_final_subject: The earliest passing source-bank boundary is at most 9, strictly earlier than the parent final-subject onset at resid:10.
predictions.pred_d_origin_contextualization: Report the cue-only curve under identical interventions; its result cannot rescue B or change the source-bank onset.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All 20 registered source-bank/cue arms produce all 64 row outcomes with finite logits and no dropped row.

terminal.screen: A, B, C, and E pass. D is descriptive. License the crossing block as the next writer-localization boundary.
terminal.null: The run is valid but no source-bank boundary through 9 passes B.
terminal.invalid: Manual identity, native capability, source alignment, boundary-0 inertness, finiteness, or coverage fails. No layer, position, threshold, or row may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First causal depth localization of the contextual source-state bank; prior work localized the final query state and L9 source contributions but not when those source representations were written.
